    GAME RULES

    How to play

    1. Play solo against the computer or share a device with another player. Each starts with 1,500 practice SNRG.
    2. Roll two dice to move. Passing City Hall adds 200 SNRG to your practice balance. Market events, grants, fees, and rent resolve when you land.
    3. You can buy the property you land on if it’s available. After rolling, you can also upgrade one property you own to increase its rent.
    4. After rolling, you can sell one property back to the city for 75% of its asset value, rounded down. The sale clears its upgrades and puts it back on the board.
    5. The player with the highest net worth after 12 rounds wins. Net worth includes cash, property purchase prices, and upgrade costs. Fees and rent can take cash below zero.
